about: The Header Group keys (ADR-0400 section 4): Alt+Shift+Down expands and Alt+Shift+Up collapses, outside the key table, so that a grid not given onHeaderGroupToggled leaves both to the page and lets a Consumer declare them. The Script Core's alone: the C# core never takes a toggle (ADR-0400 section 10; ADR-0350 section 5's note of 2026-10-27), so no C# runner reads this kind.
subject: GridKeys

ADR-0400 / HG-21: neither key is in the table, so neither is taken on a grid that toggles nothing
